versions.changelog:
Initial release of alicloud-ai-video-wan-r2v skill:

- Supports generating reference-based videos using Alibaba Cloud Model Studio Wan R2V (wan2.6-r2v-flash).
- Provides a normalized interface for multi-shot, reference-style-preserving video generation.
- Includes async task handling guidance and polling recommendations.
- Offers setup instructions, helper script, and output directory details.
